title: Calculation Techniques: Estimating, Compensating, Doubling and Halving and Inverse Operations
seo_title: Grade 5 Calculation Techniques Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Use a range of techniques to perform and check written and mental calculations of whole numbers, including estimation, building up and breaking down numbers, rounding off and compensating, doubling and halving, using a number line, and using addition and subtraction as well as multiplication and division as inverse operations.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 5 mental maths worksheets: rounding off and compensating, doubling and halving, estimating and inverse operations. 100 questions with memos.
key_sub: Estimate first; check with the inverse.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Round off and compensate: 3 456 + 198 = 3 456 + 200 − 2.
  • Double and halve: 25 × 64 = 50 × 32 = 100 × 16 = 1 600.
  • Estimate before you calculate, so you can spot a wrong answer.
  • Use inverse operations to check: + and − undo each other, × and ÷ undo each other.

Examples

Example

8 405 − 997

8 405 − 1 000 = 7 405

add back 3

Answer: 7 408

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Compensating the wrong wayYou took away 3 too many, so add 3 back.
Doubling partDouble the whole number.
Same operation to undoUndo − with +.

items.e: Keep the first digit of 1 873 and make the other digits 0: 1 000. 4 × 1 000 = 4 000. (The exact answer is 7 492. A front-end estimate is always lower than the exact answer.)

items.q: Which calculation checks 624 150 − 387 462 = 236 688?
items.e: Addition is the inverse of subtraction. Add the answer to the number you took away: 236 688 + 387 462 = 624 150. You get back to the start, so the answer is right.

items.q: Which calculation checks 800 403 − 256 718 = 543 685?
items.e: Addition is the inverse of subtraction. Add the answer to the number you took away: 543 685 + 256 718 = 800 403. You get back to the start, so the answer is right.

items.q: Which calculation checks 357 286 + 264 519 = 621 805?
items.e: Subtraction is the inverse of addition. Take one number away from the answer: 621 805 − 264 519 = 357 286. You get the other number, so the answer is right.

items.q: 738 205 − 249 687 = 488 518. Which number sentence is also true?
items.e: The three numbers make a fact family. The two smaller numbers add to make the biggest: 488 518 + 249 687 = 738 205.

items.q: 95 412 − 47 658 = 47 754. Which number sentence is also true?
